text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp to hone our skills
begins today.
—I was gazing out at the sea.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The dog days of midsummer, yet the breeze is pleasant.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah, feels like we can get off to a great start.
During last year's summer training camp, Symboli Rudolf was busy running around for the sake of the students, but...
choice_data_list: It's pretty calm this year, huh
It's nice and calm this year, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's true.
Though, of course, student council duties are waiting for me...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I judged that I, too, should experience the excitement
that all the students feel at the start of the training camp
this year.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Just as a fellow student of Tracen Academy, of course.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time to give the order.
—Let our training camp begin.
